neighbours.label: A value left open or not stated: unspecified, undisclosed, unnamed, 'that you choose', 'your choice', 'to be announced'; the same slot filled with a stated value stays quiet
fire: The contract allows other unspecified charges to be added later.
He sold the painting for an undisclosed sum last month.
You get only the reports that you choose to receive by email.
The alarm sounds at a temperature that you define in the menu.
Each player gets one bonus item (your choice) at the start.
The winners will be named at a later date.
Prizes will be awarded at a time to be determined.
The company was bought by an unnamed investor in May.
quiet: The contract allows other legal charges to be added later.
He sold the painting for a large sum last month.
You get only the reports that arrive by email.
The alarm sounds at a temperature of fifty in the menu.
Each player gets one bonus item (a coin) at the start.
The winners were named at the dinner in town.
Prizes were awarded at a ceremony in the hall.
The company was bought by a German investor in May.

short: a value left open or unstated
notes: Card: ' unspecified', ' choose', ' define', ' undisclosed', ' named' after 'to be', ' choice' after 'your'. Probe: unspecified 0.94, define 1.08, undisclosed 0.76, your choice 0.70, choose 0.52, 'to be announced' 1.48 on ' be'; filled versions (public, health, 'of ten') at most 0.09. Tested on 'unnamed', not on the card.
